declienting: Removed the Sitecore Content SDK link handling, the LinkField prop, and helpers/sitecore-link; a navigating control is now `as="a"` with an href.
Removed next/link in favour of a polymorphic `as`, so the component is not Next-only.
Renamed the colour-scheme context to surface (light/dark), which describes what it actually selects rather than how it is implemented.
Cut four variants to three: secondaryOutline collapsed into secondary, and the accent variant was dropped because it existed only to carry the client's brand red.
Mapped every --sem-button-* and --color-brand-* token onto neutral control-* semantic tokens.
Added an explicit guard so `type` is set only on a native button and aria-disabled is used otherwise; the source assumed a button element.
Kept verbatim: the surface context, the icon slots, and the disabled plus aria-disabled pairing.
